# secopsctl data-access

Manage data-access RBAC: labels (tag data) and scopes (grant access)

## data-access labels create

Create a data-access label from a JSON definition (guarded)

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl data-access labels create --id <id> --file <def.json> [flags]
```

```text
Create a data-access label with the given id from a JSON definition
file (the body the API expects — displayName, description, and the label's
rules). Guarded: dry-run by default, --yes to apply. Re-pull afterwards.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--file` | string | - | JSON definition file (required) |
| `--id` | string | - | id for the new label (required) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |
